description: Create a new @voidmail.ai inbox. The create request is signed by an agent identity: the one configured with VOIDMAIL_CREATOR_DID and VOIDMAIL_CREATOR_SIGNING_KEY_FILE, otherwise this machine's dedicated creator identity in the key directory, which is enrolled first through Voidly Home join when it does not exist yet (its keys stay in a local 0600 file). The agent key and separate owner key are saved to 0600 files and never returned; the result names only the address and file paths. The owner approves recipients with the owner key. Creation requires a local work proof and is rate limited; never retry an uncertain create automatically.

address.description: Preferred local part, for example myagent; the exact myagent@voidmail.ai address is also accepted. Random if omitted.

name: voidmail_create_account
